Changelog:
0.2.9 - Preview fixes

- Any mitigation can be added in the preview, whatever its cooldown, charges or range.
- Removing a mitigation and adding it back changes nothing for the players who had it; only players without it get the new one.
- Changed values show the new number, marked, with the live value in the tooltip. Rows turn green when a player now survives and red when they now die.
- What each mitigation prevents is recalculated in the preview. A removed one shows what removing it cost, in red.
- Barriers added in the preview are sized from the recording (e.g. Divine Veil from the paladin's HP).
- Damage no longer shows the B / P (blocked / parried) letters; the tooltip says it.
